datasets.title: sentinel_polar (synthetic drone, with ground truth)
datasets.note: The MATLAB repo's dataset25 photos with the dataset_sentinel_gt silhouettes as ground truth. Level cameras on a ring at 10 degree steps.

datasets.title: zebra (real photos, no ground truth)
datasets.note: Real turntable photos (684x461 originals shrunk to 320x216). There are no silhouettes, so IoU, false positives/negatives and RMS error are not available. The starting values come from the older reconstruction-matlab loaders for real photos (camera distance 300, focal 1000 at full size = 470 here, level cameras, a box 100 tall with x inset 20 and y outset 5 around a 100 square), not from a calibration: tune them until the bold outline sits just around the zebra in every view.
